name: Anne
source:
MC's mother. Died in a plane crash six years before the story started. 
Apparently she and MC's father, Leonard, fought quite a bit. MC and his sister, Melissa, were often sent on sleepovers to Allison's house to spare them from the yelling.

Allison mentions the Anne was 20 when MC was born. Thus she was 35 when she died and she would have been 41 by the present.
